title: DataTable
responsibility: Frames caller-owned table rows in a labelled keyboard-scrollable region without loading or transforming data.

inputs.name: DataTable.label
inputs.description: Accessible name applied to both the table and its keyboard-scrollable region.

inputs.name: DataTable.header
inputs.description: Required Svelte snippet rendered inside the table's thead. The caller supplies its header rows and any column scopes.

inputs.name: DataTable.children
inputs.description: Required Svelte snippet rendered inside the tbody when isEmpty is false. The caller owns the body data, row ordering, cell formatting, and actions.

inputs.name: DataTable.empty
inputs.description: Optional Svelte snippet rendered inside the tbody when isEmpty is true. It defaults to undefined; if omitted, the component shows No rows to display. beneath the table.

inputs.name: DataTable.isEmpty
inputs.description: Selects the empty branch instead of children and defaults to false. When true, the component renders empty if supplied or shows No rows to display. if empty is omitted.

inputs.name: DataTable.className
inputs.description: Optional class string added to the data-table scroll region and defaults to an empty string. The caller owns these feature-specific classes.

inputs.name: DataTable.tableClass
inputs.description: Optional class string assigned to the table and defaults to an empty string. The caller can use it for feature-specific table styling.

outputs.name: DataTable
outputs.description: Renders the caller's header in thead and either its body rows or the selected empty snippet in tbody. The table and keyboard-focusable region share label; an omitted empty snippet shows No rows to display. when isEmpty is true, and horizontal overflow adds a scroll hint.

errors.name: Caller content error
errors.description: DataTable does not catch errors from the supplied header, body, or empty snippets. A snippet render failure propagates through the component.
